example.title: Dumbarton Bridge (SR 84 over San Francisco Bay)

brief: Lakeshore Rd over the Miami River where it enters Lake Tamsin's western basin. Modelled on the 1982 Dumbarton Bridge: a long, low, pale concrete box-girder causeway on paired column bents across the tidal flats, rising in a smooth hump to a high-level navigation span (104 m, 26 m clearance) and down again, 2.6 km overall, with a separated bike and pedestrian path behind a concrete barrier and tall single-arm street lights. Here: the low girder trestle crosses the marshy basin, humps to a 100 m span over the channel, and comes down again. Foundations: precast concrete piles 25 m below the modelled bed.
